scope: Authored development checks and retained first-run study evidence; no independent human study.

adjustments.observed: Hidden scientific exponent could leave a passing mantissa in early development.
adjustments.change: Quarantine the whole unproven expression; final positive/negative unit checks include invisible or clipped exponents.

adjustments.observed: Initial annotation harness used plain string PDF dictionary keys and a non-subscriptable Word Comments collection.
adjustments.change: Use native PDF NameObject keys and iterate the Word collection. Final four licensed-copy exports and actual Word rendering are retained separately.

adjustments.observed: Flattened comment text could make a raised exponent look like subtraction.
adjustments.change: Label and display the verified whole value as canonical scientific notation while retaining raw text and original location in the manifest.

adjustments.observed: Development scorer classified one rounded quarantine boundary as a miss and changed a scientific value without changing its rounded display.
adjustments.change: Record the scoring amendment before held-out access; retain original attempts and corrected same-input baselines. Supported-position tolerance remains unchanged.

adjustments.observed: First held-out run misses held-050 and has 50 unknowns; one Word original has no eligible targets.
adjustments.change: Preserve first failures, disclose 16 unfilled planned slots, and make no post-held-out parser changes.

adjustments.observed: Post-lock lint rejected three long annotation-script strings.
adjustments.change: Preserve the exact at-lock annotator separately and wrap strings without changing emitted gold or frozen product files.

adjustments.observed: First installed suite completed 978 passing tests and three POSIX-only skips in 498.98 seconds, exceeding the old 480-second harness deadline. The platform receipt remains failed with exit 124 recorded for the suite.
adjustments.change: Increase the installed-suite deadline to 900 seconds and its outer platform command to 1200 seconds. Preserve every assertion and rerun the exact candidate wheel in a fresh environment.
